issue_context.title: cover.set_cover_tilt_position is not working on Fibaro FGR222 via zwave_js
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When I call cover.set_cover_tilt_position on a Fibaro FGR222 node there is no reaction. When I call zwave_js.set_value with 
- Command Class: 145
- Endpoint: 0
- Property: fibaro
- Property Key venetianBlindsTilt
- Value: 50 (example)
the device is working correctly. Would it be possible to implement the same behavoir with cover.set_cover_tilt_position? This might be less confusion for the users.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.9.6

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

zwave_js

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/zwave_js/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
This automation is behaving correctly:

  - service: zwave_js.set_value
    target:
      entity_id:
        - cover.storen_dachgeschoss_rechts
        - cover.storen_jonas
        - cover.storen_nino
    data:
      command_class: '145'
      endpoint: '0'
      property: fibaro
      property_key: venetianBlindsTilt
      value: 50
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_

We need to set the supported features attribute explicitly since we don't support stop tilt.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/d27c91b9fed08970685d0908ad25397f5d16defb/homeassistant/components/cover/__init__.py#L77-L80

See `ZwaveMotorizedBarrier` below for an example.

Done.
Many thanks for all the good inputs.
@kpine what do you think about this?

My understanding is that the driver already schedules a refresh of the value:

https://github.com/zwave-js/node-zwave-js/blob/07e601b46496a0fa4a4a24ae5317bb68eca8e258/packages/zwave-js/src/lib/commandclass/ManufacturerProprietaryCC.ts#L123

The default delay is 5 seconds. This refresh would cancel the scheduled one and issue it sooner. Not sure if that's good or bad, but it's not normal in this integration.

I don't have any comment on the `sleep` call though.
@pail23 have you tried without a manual refresh? What's the experience then?
Yes, the value is not updated. In the UI, when clicking on the slider to move the tilt position, the slider jumps back to the previous value and stays there.

Thanks for your patience with my questions.  One more, is there a reason you chose `async_refresh_cc_values` to refresh the value? Does refreshing with the value ID not work?
Ok, I confirmed with the node-zwave-js developer that this is a bug. The refresh after set is implemented incorrectly.

I was choosing `async_refresh_cc_values` because I have seen this in the zwave2mqtt UI when I pressed the refresh button. I can test refreshing with value ID as well. Which one would be the correct method to call?
Many thanks for all your help. I'm learning a lot. 
What is your proposal on how to proceed?

It would just be [`node.async_poll_value`](https://github.com/home-assistant-libs/zwave-js-server-python/blob/d8176fc3afc732be5323b529c74e1cbe3b75989f/zwave_js_server/model/node.py#L506), but it won't work. You'd have to construct a new value ID with a `tilt` property and no property key (that's the bug), e.g. `X-X-X-tilt` instead of `X-X-X-fibaro-venetianBlindsTilt`.

I submitted an issue here: https://github.com/zwave-js/node-zwave-js/issues/3611

Let's ask @MartinHjelmare if the manual polling should be removed, or left in for now.

We can keep the manual polling until the driver bug is fixed and we bump minimum version of the zwave-js-server schema. Please add a comment about this in the code above this line, and add the link to the issue.
I have add a comment in the code to remove the 2 lines once the issue is fixed.
@kpine is `async_refresh_cc_values` the best option to do the manual refresh or did you want to change that?

I just tested
```
            v = ZwaveValue(
                node=self.info.node,
                data=ValueDataType(
                    commandClass=tilt_value.command_class, endpoint=0, property="tilt"
                ),
            )
            await self.info.node.async_poll_value(v)
```
instead of
`await self.info.node.async_refresh_cc_values(tilt_value.command_class)`
--> It is working as well
Which one would you prefer?
They do the same thing in the end. For simplicity I'd keep the CC refresh. It will also work when then driver is fixed. The value poll will stop working when the driver is fixed.
This doesn't work. When you modified the platform hint, you never updated the device class attribute for that hint.
